desc: US PeaceKeeper Shotgun Scabbard is heavily padded and framed for your shotguns protection. Detachable shoulder strap allows for sling or shoulder-carry. Scabbard fits Mossberg 590 Shockwave, Remington 870 TAC-14, pistol grip Airsoft Shotgun, and multiple other shotguns with pistol grip or overall length less than 20".
